description: Build a MediaPipe-hands to TDAbleton TDA_Mapper performance control network. It outputs map1=left pinch, map2=right pinch, map3=left wrist roll, map4=right wrist roll, creates a skeleton overlay with star joints plus the thumb-index line, and optionally relinks an existing TDA_Mapper to the generated mapper_send CHOP. Uses TDAbleton directly; AbletonMCP is not required.

adapter_name.description: Hand adapter name used by setup_hand_tracking.

closed_distance.description: Distance where thumb/index are treated as closed.

coordinate_space.description: Coordinate space forwarded to setup_hand_tracking; world is best for pinch distance.

create_overlay.description: Create a skeleton overlay TOP with star joints and a thumb-index line.

ensure_hand_tracking.description: When hand_chop is omitted, run setup_hand_tracking first.

fallback_slots.description: If handedness is missing, treat slot 0 as left and slot 1 as right.

hand_chop.description: Existing hand CHOP with tx/ty/tz/confidence/handedness/screen_x/screen_y. Defaults to setup_hand_tracking's adapter output.

link_mapper.description: Try to set the TDA_Mapper Oscinputchop/Reorder/range parameters.

min_confidence.description: Minimum landmark confidence to accept a hand slot.

open_distance.description: Distance where thumb/index are treated as fully open.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP for the mapper network.

tox_path.description: Optional MediaPipe.tox path forwarded to setup_hand_tracking.

name: create_hand_ableton_mapper
title: Create hand Ableton mapper
